lines.t: The night closed in, the darkness grew The winds picked up, and trees they threw
The lights in flash, the thunder roared All around me was a storm
I couldn't find a place in this world Where I could find refuge
So I turn to you, Yahushua
When cold chaos rages all around you, keep me warm
You're the peace in the eye of the storm
Yahushua
You are my shelter, you protect me from the night
And every whisper promised
I find hope in my side
Your words calm the tempest
In your love I find solace
I find peace
Yahushua
You guide me through the stormy days
Your light shines and plays my way
Yahushua
I'm never alone with you
I'm home in your arms
I find peace
This world is drowned in shadows, lies
Eyes in deceit, face to smile but cannot hide
What they really feel inside
Sometimes I feel overwhelmed by all the chaos
But then I look to you and when I do
My sorrows flee in you
I find peace eternally
When cold chaos rages all around you
Keep me warm
You're the peace in the eye of the storm
You are my shelter, you protect me from the night
In every whispered promise, I find my hope in my sight
Your words calm the tempest
In your love I find solace, I find peace
You guide me through the stormy days
Your light shines and paves my way
I'm never alone with you
I'm home in your arms, I find peace
I'm surrounded by a storm that tries to pull me away
It tries to overwhelm me, but with you I stay
In all the chaos I find peace, Yahushua
To you I retreat
Yahushua
Yahushua
You're the peace in the hour of the storm
Yahushua
